Note that most of the content below has either been added to Stonesense, or fallen out of date with later updates to DF.  Check the history of this page for edit times!

== Vegetation ==

=== Seuss's Tweaked Vegetation ===
{{StonesenseContentPack|
|image=[[File:STV1.png]]
|download link=[http://dffd.wimbli.com/file.php?id=1699 DFFD File]
|author=Seuss
|installation=Replace vegetation folder in your stonesense directory with this one and make sure the line "vegetation/index.txt" is above "terrain/index.txt" in the main index file.
|comments=These are the vegetation files I use. I edit and change stuff as I play so this may be more updated than the official vegetation files.

An Important note:
There is a small fix to the terrain under vegetation but it will only work if in your main index.txt file you have "vegetation/index.txt" above "terrain/index.txt".
This is not necessary but it does improve visual quality.
}}

=== Belannaer's Underground trees ===
{{StonesenseContentPack|
|image=[[File:underground_trees.png]]
|download link=[http://dffd.wimbli.com/file.php?id=1980 DFFD File]
|author=Belannaer
|installation=Extract files into Stonesense/Vegetation and add underground_trees.xml to the index.txt.
|comments=New underground trees. From left to right: black cap, nether cap, goblin cap, tunnel tube, spore tree, blood thorn, fungiwood. Fungiwood graphic is from the original trees.png in Stonesense.
|included in=Slate 2.2
}}

=== Therahedwig's darker grass ===
{{StonesenseContentPack|
|image=http://img.ie/164bc.png
|download link=[http://dffd.wimbli.com/file.php?id=3617 DFFD File]
|author=TheraHedwig
|installation=Just unzip the file inside the stonesense directory and add GD/index.txt to the index file, above all the other entries.
